title.en: Carpentry Workshop Scheduling and Materials Assistant
title.zh: 木工工坊排期与材料助理

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Maintain a workshop schedule from approved build sequences and communicate collection changes.
requirements.zh: 依据获批制作顺序维护工坊排期，并沟通取件变更。

requirements.en: Check deliveries, reserve specified materials and follow up on missing fittings.
requirements.zh: 核对到货、预留指定材料，并跟进缺失五金配件。

requirements.en: Keep job packets linked to current drawing revisions and purchase-order references.
requirements.zh: 将工单资料包与当前图纸修订版及采购订单编号关联。

requirements.en: Prepare useful shift handovers and maintain customer collection records.
requirements.zh: 准备实用的轮班交接，并维护客户取件记录。
